chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from his father, from Ibn Abi Umayr, from Hisham ibn Salim who said:

I said to Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him): What is the right of Allah over His creation? He said: That they should say what they know, and refrain from what they do not know, so if they do that, they have fulfilled the right of Allah.
ai.seo_question: What is the primary right of Allah upon His creation according to Imam al-Sadiq?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) defines the fundamental right of Allah upon His creation as speaking only what one knows and remaining silent about what one does not know. Fulfilling this condition of truthful speech and avoiding baseless claims constitutes the discharge of one's primary duty towards God.

en.ammaar-muslim: 4. [4/-] al-Kafi: Ali from his father from Ibn Abi Umayr from Hisham b. Salim who said:

I said to Abi Abdillah عليه السلام: what is the right of Allāh over his creation? he said: that they should only say that which they know and should remain silent over that which they do not know – so if they were to do that then they have fulfilled the right of Allāh.
